faq_heading: Homes near W J Mouat Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the W J Mouat Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Abbotsford School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the W J Mouat Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names W J Mouat Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to W J Mouat Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Clearbrook Elementary (1.0 km north), John Maclure Community School (1.0 km east) and Ten Broeck Elementary (1.4 km south-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of W J Mouat Secondary

23 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of W J Mouat Secondary in a straight line (12 elementary, 5 secondary, 3 middle, 3 other; 4 independent). The closest is Clearbrook Elementary, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is Abbotsford Senior Secondary School, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Rick Hansen Secondary (2.3 km); the nearest independent school is Mennonite Educational Institute (2.1 km). Other secondary schools close by: Rick Hansen Secondary (2.3 km west), St. John Brebeuf Regional Secondary (2.3 km west), Bakerview Centre for Learning (2.6 km south), Bakerview Centre for Learning - CE (2.6 km south), Abbotsford Senior Secondary School (3.0 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (9-12) is Rick Hansen Secondary, 2.3 km west of W J Mouat Secondary.
